tagline: 雅西卡数码单反相机，1968 年发布
description: 雅西卡于1968年推出的数码单反相机。配备M42 screw mount Auto Yashinon DX 50mm 1:1.7。快门速度1-1/1000 and B。使用135, 35mm。

specs.曝光测光: non TTL, top plate mounted CdS with top window readout
specs.电池: PX625, for meter only, easily substituted by a 675 air-zinc.
specs.镜头: M42 screw mount Auto Yashinon DX 50mm 1:1.7
specs.英文简介: The J-7 was introduced by Yashica circa 1966, a continuation of the M42-lensed SLR series begun with the Penta J.
